title: COPY ... REPLACING — preprocessor-level include with token substitution; affects compile-time layout
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTOMER-RECORD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> COPY pulls in a copybook (header file). REPLACING does
      *> token-level substitution. The actual record layout is
      *> hidden until you find COPYBOOK-CUSTREC. Migrating without
      *> resolving COPY first leaves the rewrite blind to what
      *> fields exist.
       01  WS-CUSTOMER.
           COPY COPYBOOK-CUSTREC REPLACING
              ==:PFX:==  BY  ==WS-CUST==
              ==:SIZE:== BY  ==30==.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY WS-CUSTOMER.
           STOP RUN.
notes: COPY REPLACING is the COBOL macro system. The actual record layout depends on the copybook + substitutions. The spec must enumerate the resolved layout — leaving the COPY unresolved means the rewrite is missing fields.
